summary: Build Python AI prototypes, evaluate models, and assess AI risks. Explore the five-day course outline and practical outcomes.
lede: Applied artificial intelligence training helps technical teams assess whether a use case is feasible, testable, and ready for review. For software developers, data analysts, machine learning engineers, and systems engineers, it covers preparing data in Python, building baseline models, evaluating performance and errors, testing generative AI outputs, and tracking experiments. Participants also develop review artefacts, including an evaluation checklist, risk register, and deployment-readiness plan; advanced deployment architecture and governance are covered at an overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for technical professionals who need to evaluate or contribute to practical AI projects, from data preparation through prototype review and deployment planning.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of Python, basic statistics, and tabular data is expected. Coding is required for notebook exercises. No prior machine-learning deployment experience is required; advanced deployment architecture and formal AI management-system implementation are covered at an operational overview level.
